description: Create a new ABAP structure in SAP system. Creates the structure object in initial state.

activate.description: Activate structure after creation. Default: true. Set to false for batch operations (activate multiple objects later).

description.description: Structure description. If not provided, structure_name will be used.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

fields.description: Does not reach creation — the shipped create endpoint posts a metadata document only. Use UpdateStructure (with ddl_code) after creating to set the fields.

data_element.description: Data element name for type reference (optional)

data_type.description: Data type: CHAR, NUMC, DATS, TIMS, DEC, INT1, INT2, INT4, INT8, CURR, QUAN, etc.

decimals.description: Decimal places (for DEC, CURR, QUAN types)

includes.description: Does not reach creation — see `fields`. Use UpdateStructure (with ddl_code) after creating to set includes.

master_language.description: Optional master/original language for the created object (e.g. "EN", "DE", "ZH"). Defaults to the session language (SAP_LANGUAGE) or EN.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task. Required for transportable packages.

name: CreateStructure
